prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a small transparent animated icon on a fashion workflow website
Primary request: Create one square source sheet with EXACTLY four equal square panels arranged 2x2. Show the SAME compact premium miniature white-clay industrial sewing machine icon in four tiny successive motion phases. Include a simple machine body, a clearly visible needle, a strip of fabric under the needle, and one small round gear/handwheel at the right. Phase 1: gear rests, needle raised. Phase 2: gear rotates a little and needle begins lowering. Phase 3: gear rotates further while needle stitches into cloth. Phase 4: needle rises and gear returns near the starting angle. Keep the entire design and camera consistent; motion is only the rotating gear and tiny needle/fabric advance. Clearly represent garment industrialization/production.
Scene/backdrop: transparent, no environment.
Subject: exactly one small industrial sewing machine with fabric feed and turning circular gear, repeated consistently in four tiles.
Style/medium: charming premium softly rounded white-clay/paper 3D miniature icon, matte white surfaces, pale neutral-grey dimensional shading, elegant refined fashion illustration, friendly and sophisticated; same material style as a premium tactile clay product icon, not vector.
Composition/framing: fixed camera, three-quarter front view, same centered machine silhouette, scale, perspective and soft lighting in every equal square tile; generous transparent margin around each; strict 2x2 layout without separators.
Lighting/mood: gentle diffused studio lighting, subtle clean contact shadows.
Color palette: white and pale neutral grey only; actual transparent alpha.
Materials/textures: rounded porcelain-clay housing, paper-like fabric and subtly embossed gear details.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: exactly four related sequential motion phases; same machine in every tile; no extra scene; preserve transparent alpha.
Avoid: people, hands, extra objects, colors, beige, black background, labels, letters, numbers, watermark, visible grid, panel borders, separators, cropped objects, changing camera, crude flat line art.
